status: frozen before any Rust output exists; relaxing a tolerance after a failure is prohibited — a failing configuration gets its own quality gate and version instead
reference: benchmarks/goldens/<profile>/cpu/<fixture>.json (pinned Python, float32, torch 2.14.0, complete network incl. action head)

evidence_basis.python_cpu_determinism: bitwise identical across repeated forwards for every fixture and profile

python_mps_vs_cpu.tensors: input_ids/attention_mask/marker_pos/marker_mask/qtype exactly equal on all 29 fixtures × 3 profiles

native_rounded_field_flips.note: all are ±1 in the fourth decimal on values whose unrounded form lies within 1e-5 of a rounding boundary

exact: state_text and per-question head_text / option_texts strings
ids, markers, sequence lengths, truncation counts
batch.input_ids, attention_mask, marker_pos, marker_mask, qtype, pad_id
legend, probability key order, answer key insertion order
error class for upstream-failing fixtures (options that cannot fit max_len; single-option choice) unless an explicit documented adapter policy replaces it

rust_cpu_fp32.argmax: 100% agreement, except questions where the top-two unrounded Python probabilities differ by < 1e-5 (reported as near-ties, listed explicitly, must still agree on the rounded probability map)
rust_cpu_fp32.native_rounded_fields: |diff| <= 1e-4 + 1e-9 per field (a single last-digit flip); flips must be listed and must not exceed 2% of questions per profile

rust_metal_fp32.compares_to: python cpu goldens (primary) and python mps goldens (cross-check, reported)
rust_metal_fp32.finite_outputs: every logit/probability must be finite on every fixture

rust_metal_fp16_or_bf16.status: separate measured configuration; never reported as the fp32 result
rust_metal_fp16_or_bf16.argmax: >= 99% agreement excluding near-ties (top-two unrounded gap < 5e-3); every disagreement listed
rust_metal_fp16_or_bf16.native_rounded_fields: reported, not gated; any two-decimal Jev-wire field change is listed

cuda_mixed_precision.status: not declared — no NVIDIA hardware available at L0; must be declared from a Python CUDA reproducibility run before any Rust CUDA delta is inspected

quantized.status: not declared — separate quality gate and version required (plan §4)

comparison_procedure: For each profile and fixture compare Rust output to the cpu golden; report max/mean/RMSE per field, list every argmax disagreement and rounded-field flip with both values; a gate passes only if every fixture passes for every supported profile. Fixtures with an upstream `error` record must produce the documented error class in Rust.
